# compact

Reclaim space by compacting a database or its view indexes

## Synopsis

```
cdb compact <db-path> [flags]
```

## Description

Reclaim space by compacting a database or its view indexes.

Compaction rewrites a database file without the old revisions of its
documents, and usually reclaims a great deal of space. It is safe — the
database stays readable and writable throughout — but it is long-running on a
large database and it needs room for a second copy of the file while it runs,
so cdb asks before starting one.

--ddoc compacts one design document's view indexes instead of the database.
--cleanup additionally deletes the view index files left behind by design
documents that have changed or been removed; it runs after the compaction is
requested, not instead of it.

--watch follows the matching entry in _active_tasks until it disappears.
CouchDB compacts a small database faster than the first poll, so a watch that
has seen no task after ten seconds reports the compaction as finished.

Destructive: asks for confirmation unless `--yes` is given.

## Arguments

Takes exactly 1 argument.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cleanup` | bool | `false` | also delete orphaned view index files |
| `--ddoc` | string |  | compact this design document's view indexes instead of the database |
| `--watch` | bool | `false` | follow the compaction until it finishes |

## Global flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anonymous` | bool | `false` | connect without credentials, and do not ask for any |
| `--color` | string |  | colour: auto, always or never |
| `--format` | string |  | output format: table or json |
| `--json` | bool | `false` | print raw JSON instead of a table |
| `--pager` | string |  | pager command, or off |
| `--path` | string |  | starting virtual path |
| `--profile` | string |  | connection profile to use, overriding CDB_PROFILE and the default |
| `--replication-url` | string |  | address the server should use to reach itself for replication, overriding the profile and CDB_REPLICATION_URL |
| `--url` | string |  | server URL, overriding the profile and CDB_URL |
| `--verbose` | bool | `false` | include raw status codes and reasons in errors |
| `--yes` | bool | `false` | skip confirmation prompts |

## Examples

```
$ cdb compact /movies
Compact movies? [y/N] y
Compaction of movies started.

$ cdb compact /movies --watch --yes
$ cdb compact /movies --ddoc by_year --cleanup --yes
```
